items.body:
There is a substantial list of attributes that sets Ran Blake apart from every other innovative pianist of the past sixty-plus years, each of which falls under one of two headings: his choice of materials and his treatments of them. The former is based on Blake’s ability to hear connections between materials for which “disparate” is an inadequate descriptor. Who else would sequence Max Roach’s “Mendacity” and “Saving All My Love for You” – or “On Top of Old Smokey” and Michel Legrand’s “Watch What Happens”? Nobody, because what Blake does is unique. He doesn’t interpret materials as much as administer an MRI, revealing the connective tissues and vital organs as vividly, if not more so, than the skeletal structure. In the process, Blake makes the familiar sound radically new.

Blake’s collaborations with singers are central to his work. The current critical consensus is that his groundbreaking work with Jeanne Lee overshadows everything since, the respective qualities of notables like Christine Correa and Sara Serpa notwithstanding. Roots & Byways circumvents the edifice The Newest Sound Around has become, primarily because Dominique Eade takes a different tact. She is not as rooted as Correa – or Lee, for that matter – in Billie Holiday, and she is not as committed to understatement as Serpa. Like both Correa and Serpa, Eade can shape a song syllable by syllable and render a highly personal interpretation. It is Eade’s palpably deep joy in singing that sets her apart, one that is not only bursting at the seams on showstoppers like the Whitney Houston megahit, but one that even seeps into noirish songs like Mingus’ “Portrait.” It is the key to her relatability and appeal, and to that of the album, as well.

items._cn_summary: Ran Blake的钢琴与Dominique Eade的人声合作专辑展现出独特的材料选择与处理方式。Blake以非同寻常的方式将风格跨度极大的曲目并置——从Max Roach到Michel Legrand，从民谣到流行金曲——揭示它们之间隐藏的联系结构，使熟悉的作品焕发全新面貌。Eade的演唱以深沉而外溢的喜悦为核心特质，逐音节塑造歌曲的个人化诠释，既能处理辉煌的流行大热曲目，也能渗透进Mingus式的暗黑氛围。与Blake此前合作的歌手相比，Eade既不拘泥于Billie Holiday的传统根基，也不走向Serpa式的克制路线，而是以饱满的情感表达形成自身的感染力与亲和力。专辑整体回避了被经典化的合作范式，在曲目编排与演绎方式上体现出鲜明的个人审美视角。

Though this recording documents the work of thirteen of Belgium's most innovative ensembles, the real star is the Park Abbey located just outside Leuven and founded in 1129. Though this recording documents the work of thirteen of Belgium's most innovative ensembles, the real star is the Park Abbey located just outside Leuven and founded in 1129. Built and maintained for the purpose of quiet meditation, the abbey hosted the musicians who used the quiet surroundings to prepare and record their unique musical imaginings. The result is a mostly instrumental collection that mines the riches of Belgian folk and world music traditions, including Romani scales,
La Pump
rhythms, and accordion-based
bal-musette
flavors.
For example, Slovenian-native R�n�lius Bikar�s searing violin opens the set with �R�fuge.� He and his self-named ensemble channel pan-European Roma history.
Meanwhile, �Poor Boy� is a Django Reinhardt-inspired swing tune by Charlotte Pelgen & Bipolar Bows. Pelgen sings in English, and with her ukulele strumming sounding very much like a tenor banjo, the tune is enlivened by Lotte Remmen�s St�phane Grappelli-like fiddle lines.
The distinctive sound of the oud announces yet another musical tradition. Blending Mediterranean with Arabic sounds, the Lebanese-Belgian singer Amber Haddad and her trio, oudist Adil Benhsain and double bassist Martijn Vanbuel, spin a beguiling musical web. According to the liner notes (translated from the Dutch), �Tawazden� is about �seeking balance and finding peace within a complex environment.� Further, �the various spaces of the abbey and their murals are the direct source of inspiration.�
The accordion is especially prominent. So too is the Western classical tradition. Sounding almost Baroque, �Sacristia Invisibilis,� is another standout for me. Here, mandolinist Andries Boone is joined by Anouk Sanczuk on octave violin (sometimes called the baritone violin, tuned an octave lower than standard) and on harpsichord Sandra Van der Gucht. They create an indescribable sound you have to hear.
Throughout, the Abbey�s stone presence looms. Aur�lie Charneux�s solo clarinet piece �L'Ape Millenaria� is about a thousand-year-old bee that haunts the abbey. �Thila,� by Enara Navaira, evokes ancient Celts with a jazzy double bass and drum kit behind throat singing and Citera (a kind of Hungarian zither).
Airboxes is a duo who mix chromatic and diatonic accordions. Their offering �Abdij 1� sounds improvised. Again from the liner notes, �they share their impressions of the timelessness of monastic life.�
Despite the wide range of styles,
The Sound of the Abbey
has a coherence, perhaps informed by the artists� shared inspiration. The record is often surprising and always soothing. Three years in the making, the ensembles were lovingly recorded and mixed by Bert Huysentruyt and mastered by Pieter De Wagter from Equus Mastering. They have rendered a warm sound using the natural reverb of ancient stone provided by the project�s silent partner.

items.body: "There is no such thing as a stranger�s children." - old Ukrainian saying I�ve long been affected, indeed somewhat obsessed, by what�s happening in Ukraine, partly because of one of my favorite bands, DakhaBrakha. I went to Kyiv to see them at the time of the Maidan protests, just after the shooting by snipers of over a hundred protesters. I intentionally didn�t read this album�s booklet notes before listening, so that I could react to it without sympathetic pre-judgement, just as music. It�s strong musically and vocally by any standards, Ukrainian or otherwise. When I did then turn to the notes that translate and explain the songs, I had that rare experience, for me, of becoming moist-eyed. The songs are a mix of traditional and original. They are focused on the abduction by Russia of about 20,000 Ukrainian children who have been taken from their parents in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine and sent to Russia, in an attempt to turn them into haters of their native land and people. It�s a heinous war crime. Marichka is a Ukrainian-Canadian singer who moves between Canada and her homeland. For this album she�s gathered two groups of musicians, one in each country. Both ensembles contribute vocals and instrumentation, mostly bowed strings, plus some bandura and piano. The group in Ukraine includes Lisa from the destroyed and invaded city of Mariupol, playing a solo on double ocarina; at 16 she was one of the stolen children but managed to return to Ukraine. Daughters of Donbas � co-led by Marichka and singer/bandurist Alina Kuzma, who shares the lead vocal role � is an all-female ensemble in Canada that tours performing these songs. �Foreign Land� is a reworking of a traditional song about the young girls who were sent away to work in foreign households - Marichka�s grandmother was one of these - that can also be taken to refer to the plight of today�s stolen children. The translation goes: A mother packed up her daughter To leave for a strange land To a strange land with strange people Oh, who will pity you, my daughter? Those who will beat me will pity me I'll never again live with you, my mother When, my daughter, should I expect you to come home? When the grass in the garden grows, my mother The grass grew and grew and began to dry The mother was waiting for her daughter to return, and began to cry Did you hear, my mother, how I came to you? How I flew as a bird above your window? How I cooed like a dove? If, my daughter, I could hear you I would open all the doors and windows To let you fly in Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Alina Kuzma, Zo� Santo As befits the song, Marichka�s vocal here is gentle. But in the second track, �Rusalka,� with Alina Kuzma taking the lead vocals, things turn harsh and fierce. A rusalka is a mythical creature, a nature spirit of fields, forest and rivers, that features in traditional ritual songs. The melody of this one is by Zo� Santo and Kuzma, with lyrics drawing on tradition and the composition of Santo and 19thC Ukrainian poet and folklorist Taras Shevchenko. An ominous double-bass drone, chunking strings, a slithering vocal that moves into sections of white-voice fast recitative and expands into a soaring wild cry. The lyrics are very dark, perhaps evoking the hell of the front line: Home a hell of old growth stumps Marsh a mud of memories Don�t get bogged down in these parts Your kind won�t last a day in here While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. A rusalka sat on a white birch, rusalky asked girls for shirts. Long fingers and nails so sharp Tongue forked round serrated teeth Moss grows down beneath her parts Weeds braided from ear to ear While witches still fly, while roosters have yet to crow, Come here, something arises, �neath the oak something walks. �Girls, my friends, give me your shirts. Though I�m thin, give me a thin one.� Here live us the backless ones Many voices of dead sons You are right to quake in fear Send your sinful children here �Who Am I� is a plea of separation and disorientation, the pain and confusion of an abducted child, contrasting �the human in me� and �the creature in me,� like an internalized riddle-song, with the refrain, in English: Who am I for you? Who am I for me? Do you know me? Really know me? �Enchantress,� passionately sung by Kuzma to her own bandura accompaniment, a girl�s lament of the loss of her brave love taken from her by the enchantress, who is an allegory of war, is based on a traditional song and uses that style of melody and lyrics, �Riddle,� sung by Marichka, reworks a traditional riddle song to be the riddles told by the grandfather of a child, 12-year-old Kira from Mariupol, who experienced the death of her father and her abduction to Russia. Her grandfather tracked her down, and brought her back, traumatized, and asked her riddles - as the notes say �to jog her memory, and remind her who she was, where her home was, and of her family�s love for her.� Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �4.5.0� is a military expression for �all�s well� or �all is quiet.� The song is a message, as from a mother, to a stolen child. Marichka�s voice is cherishing: Remember this: I am with you, I am here Don't give up, I'm with you. Don't give up, I'm with you Your hope is my weapon Don't be sad, I'm with you 4.5.0. will be again �breaking into a tearing howl: And when the world's axis breaks When the sky folds like a parchment Out of nowhere her words will come� �and back to fragile reassurance �It's all right, I'm here, I'm here� "Lullaby," based on a traditional lullaby, sung by Alina Kuzma to accompaniment by her bandura and Zo� Santo's viola, starts in gentle lullaby style, but moves to a lament; it's for the stolen children and those who, as the notes put it, 'have been stolen for ever.' Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, Marichka �Remember, I Believe in You� is a powerful piece of harmonizing vocals and slithering strings. Here�s the story it�s based on: Yevhen lived in Mariupol with his three young children. During the siege they lived in a basement bomb shelter for months. One day, Russian soldiers entered their bomb shelter. Yevhen was taken to a filtration camp and separated from his children who were all taken to a hospital and then to Russian summer �camp�. In the filtration camp Yevhen was brutally tortured and forced to sleep standing on one leg. He tried to fall asleep, whispering prayers for his children: �Everything will be fine, I believe in you.� After his release he walked 30 kilometers to the place where his children had been taken but it was too late. They had already been sent to Moscow. Yevhen learned of this after receiving a text from one of his children who had found an unattended device. He traveled thousands of kilometers, crossed the borders of three countries, endured checks, interrogations and danger to reach Moscow and take his children home. All those days he tirelessly repeated to himself, �I believe in myself, I believe in my kids. Everything will be good.� �Another Heaven,� sung by Marichka with the ensemble in Ukraine, is inspired by another heart-rending story: Ilya was 9 years old when his mother was killed by a rocket strike right in front of him. He was taken to a hospital in occupied Donetsk, where 15 pieces of shrapnel were removed from his body without anesthesia. After he appeared in a report on Russian television, Ilya�s grandmother learned his location. She managed to bring her grandson to Kyiv, where he lives now, experiencing missile attacks every night. At age 11, he says that it is up to everyone to fight enemies, to protect other cities, and to build another heaven, where your home will not be destroyed. In 2014, during the Kyiv Maidan protests, Marichka wrote and performed �Red Boots Tango,� using a melody she�d put to a poem by Taras Shevchenko. For this album she sings it again in Ukraine, with the ensemble there adding swirling, classic tango-style strings. Songs of Stolen Children by Daughters of Donbas, BanduraGirl The final track on the album is a solo, recorded in Kyiv, by Anastasiya Voytyuk, accompanying herself on the older, simpler form of bandura that was used by kobzars to accompany epic poetry, and also on the nowadays more well-known big, heavy form developed from it in Soviet times that was made mainly in the piano factory at Chernihiv. Her song, �Soon I Will Be Back,� is based on a poem by novelist, journalist and war crime researcher Victoria Amelia, who was killed in 2023, in the city of Kramatorsk in Donbas, by a Russian rocket. items.body: A confession to begin: I�ve been a fan of Alison Cotton�s music for quite a while, so the announcement of a new album definitely brought me a frisson of delight. The Gods Laugh certainly doesn�t disappoint, with the same deliciously amorphous feel that�s defined her other work, drawing on folk, the avant-garde, as well as a sense of religiosity to make the music here, possibly best exemplified in �I Am!�, where she set a poem by John Clare, England�s great nature poet, to a transcendent melody over the constant underpinning of a lulling drone. While the playing revolves around her usual arsenal of viola, harmonium, hammered dulcimer, and piano, along with some percussion, on this album she also adds some drums, bass and synthesizer. The music is often improvised and captured in a single take, with an almost mystical, hushed sensibility that seems to reach through time, as with �I Still Know You are Calling My Name,� where the tune could have been plucked from an old folk song. Sprigs of Heather by Alison Cotton The centerpiece, however, is �Sprigs of Heather,� with an opening that recalls medieval sacred music that becomes a simple, slowly cascading, piano-led melody. It�s far from the longest track on the album, but a little pearl of perfection that carries the listener away. Sprigs of Heather by Alison Cotton The Gods Laugh is a memorial of sorts to Cotton�s father, who died in late 2024. There�s a sense of loss reaching across these tracks, most specifically present on �The Final Harvest,� a solemn piece about her father�s last visit to the allotment he loved so much. It�s suffused with tenderness that extends beyond words. Light and darkness bleed into each other across the music, and moods shift. It�s music that happily stands beyond category, with hints of so many things, but ultimately standing as Alison Cotton music, which might well be all the definition it needs. It will challenge you but also satisfy and move you. What more can you wish from music? Find the artist online. More to hear: United States of Alchemy - Songs of Compassion (Review) Dani Jan� - Vida (Review)

items._cn_summary: Alison Cotton 的新专辑横跨民谣、前卫与当代古典之间，以中提琴、簧风琴、击弦古钢琴与钢琴为核心编制，并加入鼓、贝斯与合成器拓宽声场。作品多为一次即兴录制完成，带有神秘而低语的灵性气质，多首曲目从中世纪圣咏与古老民谣中汲取旋律素材，以持续的低音长音为基底展开冥想式的氛围。专辑是为纪念2024年底去世的父亲而作，失落与温柔的情绪贯穿始终，尤其是描述父亲最后一次前往他所钟爱的菜园的作品，沉静而克制。光与暗在不同曲目之间交替渗透，音乐最终超越了任何单一类型标签，成为难以归类却高度统一的个人化表达。

items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._cn_summary: 本合辑聚焦贝宁传奇乐队Orchestre Poly-Rythmo与歌曲创作者Antoine Dougbé的合作，由Analog Africa厂牌发行，跨越1977至1982年的录音。Dougbé被称为'魔鬼首相'，其音乐根植于伏都教传统，并以拍腿节奏Cavacha为标志，该节奏由鼓手Belobi Meridjo受火车节奏启发而创作，后风靡刚果流行乐坛。乐评指出，这些录音年代较晚，吉他带有塑料质感，合成器出现，但音乐仍扎根于1970年代。Cuban son的影响在专辑早期曲目中尤为明显，刚果伦巴的律动也贯穿其中。乐评以《Ma Won Min Towe Leo》和《We Tayi Sin Assi Tche》为例，分析了合成器铺底、闪亮吉他与高帽节奏的交织，以及古巴风格的牛铃与鼻音呼应对唱。作为Analog Africa推出的第四张Poly-Rythmo相关合辑，此专辑旨在揭示Dougbé短暂而有力的录音生涯中尚未被国际乐界充分认知的一面。

items.body: Tako Toki are like desert island musicians who, castaway without their instruments, were forced to construct their own. Lucky for us, they are as skilled in making instruments as they are in creating original songs with which to show off their handicrafts. Un Dimanche � Monaco is the band�s follow-up to their well-received debut, Hirsute Farfelus , with a similar mash of musical styles. Before discussing the music, we need to talk about their instrument closet. They really have built everything they play out of bric-a-brac, odds and ends, and rubbish. I�m not sure from listening which is which, but they call their instruments, in an incomplete list, tassofons, tilofons, and tubofones, clarinuts, didjerimou, and klarbass, and my favorite, kitchenofon. (I will refer to what I hear by the names of store-bought instruments that they sound like.) The most surprising thing for me was how accurate the instruments were to pitch and how good they sounded under the harsh scrutiny of modern recording microphones that have documented a rich, high-quality sound. UN DIMANCHE A MONACO - LP by Tako Toki They have also very effectively matched their choice of instruments with the style of music that inspires their compositions. Right off the top, �Yinitza� features a laughing clarinet singing a klezmer tune accompanied by bassoon for the bass, frantic two-time percussion, and the exuberant human yelps found on many klezmer recordings. As on this track, many tunes feature improvisations that show an impressive degree of musicianship. On the cumbia-inspired �Le Cuenta,� the characteristic flute carries the tune, augmented by a Spanish singing chorus, and remarkably rich-sounding Latin percussion. The title track surrounds us with afrobeat woodblocks, shakers, and rattles scattered around the mix. The melody is played on a marimba ornamented with bells and cymbals. Again, the lead player improvises over the tune and often against the beat with jazzy chops. The flute returns on the samba-inspired �Ambiguidade,� and on �Aksum� it traces a trance-like Middle Eastern tune reminiscent of a 60s TV spy-show theme. UN DIMANCHE A MONACO - LP by Tako Toki Full of fun and one of a kind, Un Dimanche � Monaco celebrates our universal love of rhythmic, melodic, and harmonic sounds and the varied, wonderful ways cultures have organized that love in what we call music. At the same time, playing on literal pieces of junk, Tako Tiko reminds us, as we contemplate many mall music shops filled with gleaming wood and brass instruments and countless unused guitars lying in closets, that musicians will always find a way to make music. Find the artist online. Further reading: Tako Toki - Hirsute Farfelus (Review) Terje Isungset - Glacial Poetry (Review)

items.body: After the extra-terrestial explorations of Eventyrferd , the previous album from Norway's Camilla Hole Trio, in which sci-fi synth sounds were married with traditional material, their latest release Langs is rather more earthbound. But the quest to look beyond their own country's folk music continues. Camilla Hole's main instrument being the soprano sax, the influence of jazz is unsurprising and this is evident in the opening track �Springleik,� signifying a tune used to accompany the springleik dance from the west of Norway. Initially Hole takes the melody with Egil Kalman and Knut Kvifte Nesheim providing rhythmic support on double bass and drums respectively, with the overdubbing of Kalman's modular synth and Nesheim's vibraphone adding colour. But characteristically for this trio, in which assigned roles are never clearly defined or adhered to, things soon start to move around, with Kalman taking up the melody on his bass, playing the melody in unison with Hole, while Nesheim opens things out further rhythmically. As the whole piece takes on a much more improvisatory feel, Hole plays the melody one more time as things draw to a close. Langs by Camilla Hole Trio

items._cn_summary: 挪威Camilla Hole Trio在专辑《Langs》中延续了前作《Eventyrferd》的探索路径，但将重心从科幻合成器实验回归到更接地气的民间音乐素材。主奏乐器为高音萨克斯，融合挪威西部民间舞曲旋律与自由即兴爵士语汇，三位成员角色分配模糊，旋律线在高音萨克斯与低音提琴之间自由流转，鼓手则以节奏扩展推动即兴张力。作品以模块合成器与颤音琴叠加音色层次，将传统旋律置于爵士即兴框架内重新解构，既保留了挪威民间舞曲的文化根源，又通过开放的角色轮换和即兴结构打破传统编曲逻辑。对于关注跨界即兴与世界音乐融合的听众而言，这张专辑展现了北欧音乐场景中传统与现代对话的一种独特路径。

items.body: Kr�ta , the latest release on Norway's Taragot label, features a Swede and two Norwegians playing interpretations of mainly traditional tunes from their respective countries. Fiddler Mats Ed�n has long been involved in Swedish folk music, as a player, composer and teacher, and in the process exploring and integrating different musical styles and approaches. Tellef Kvifte was in the pioneering Norwegian crossover band Slinkombas in the 1970s and has continued to play a central role in Norwegian folk music, both as a musician and an academic. Most often heard playing the sj�fl�yte , more widely known as a recorder, Kvifte has employed other instruments from outside the Norwegian tradition, in particular the saxophone and bagpipes. His son Knut Kvifte Nesheim , a drummer and composer, has also shown a determination to blur the lines between different musical genres, both in his solo and group projects. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio It comes as no surprise then to find this trio offering a far from conventional take on the tunes they have chosen. While dance tunes may be the source of most of the material here, this feels more akin to chamber music; not that it is remotely classical in style, but in the sense it conveys of three players engrossed in a musically intimate conversation. This is not a performance appropriate for accompanying dancers but might instead be seen as an exploration of hidden possibilities of meaning in the music. In so doing it reveals some of its underlying mystery, including, perhaps, a darker side. Just as in an Ibsen play, where the surface bonhomie, jollity and social nicety can be hiding something more sinister, in Scandinavian dance music there are at times hints of a troublesome undercurrent below the surface. So the decision to open proceedings with �Fossgrimen,� a fiddle tune from Norway's Setesdal valley, is perhaps significant. A fossgrimen is a mythical creature, a kind of water-sprite living in waterfalls from whom fiddle-players were considered to have learned their skills and for that were not universally welcomed, with the fiddle considered to be the devil's instrument. Kr�ta by Ed�n/Kvifte/Nesheim trio Tellef Kvifte takes the lead melody on most tracks but on the Swedish �Polska from Per Myhr,� having played a repeated introductory riff on the sj�fl�yte, with Mats Ed�n providing an amorphous textural accompaniment below and Nesheim adding some quiet tinkling, it's Ed�n who introduces the tune on the fiddle with Kvifte proceeding to play in unison. It's a short track and almost as soon as it gets going things start to fragment and everything grind to a halt.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由瑞典小提琴家与挪威父子演奏家组成三重奏，以斯堪的纳维亚传统舞曲素材为出发点，却完全跳脱出舞蹈伴奏的语境，呈现为近似室内乐质感的私密音乐对话。演奏者各自具备跨流派经验：小提琴手长期探索瑞典民间音乐并融合多元风格，竖笛/萨克斯/风笛演奏者曾参与挪威先锋跨界乐队，鼓手则积极模糊音乐类型界限。专辑开篇选用挪威塞特达尔山谷的"瀑布精灵"曲调，暗指民间传说中提琴与魔鬼仪式的关联，暗示舞曲表面欢愉之下隐藏的不安暗流。曲目中旋律在传统素材上不断裂解、延展，节奏碎片化，文本层与主旋律交织后归于静止，整体呈现出对民间音乐深层意义的探索而非传统演绎。

items.body: French industrial project HORSKH has released “Connected“, a collaboration with Carpenter Brut, on September 10, 2026, ahead of HORSKH’s forthcoming album “MTNT”. HORSKH’s official Bandcamp credits the track jointly to HORSKH and Carpenter Brut, with mixing and mastering by Thibault Chaumont at Deviant Lab Studio and artwork by Johanna Jaskowska. Connected by HORSKH “Connected” also appears on HORSKH’s forthcoming album “MTNT”, listed as a ten-track release scheduled for September 25, 2026, issued through Wire Control under exclusive licence to Blood Blast Distribution. “Connected” and the earlier single “Glow” are both tied directly to “MTNT”. The lyrics give the collaboration a considerably less comfortable meaning than its title suggests. Images of wires, intravenous connection, fear, chemical illusion and an attachment that persists despite attempts to escape recur throughout the song, placing bodily, technological and psychological attachment close together rather than treating “connection” as straightforward communication. The pairing brings together two French projects that approach heavy electronic music from different but intersecting angles. HORSKH’s recent catalogue has increasingly combined guitars, electronic programming and industrial pressure: “BODY” arrived in January 2024, following “WIRE” in 2021 and “GATE” in 2017. Carpenter Brut, meanwhile, released his latest studio album “Leather Temple” on February 27, 2026. The two releases share a technical link as well: “Leather Temple” was mixed and mastered by Thibault Chaumont at Deviant Lab, the same studio and engineer credited on “Connected”. “MTNT” arrives on September 25, 2026. “Connected” is available now through HORSKH’s official Bandcamp and streaming platforms. About HORSKH HORSKH are based in Besançon, France. Their recorded catalogue dates back to the “DAWN” EP, released in October 2014 and followed by an expanded edition in 2015. Their first full-length album, “GATE”, arrived on April 10, 2017, followed by “WIRE” on January 22, 2021 and “BODY” on January 19, 2024. The credits for “GATE” and “WIRE” list Bastien on programming, keyboards, vocals and guitar, Briou on live drums, and Jordan on guitar and keyboards. “WIRE” was mixed by Sam Munnier and Bastien Hennaut and mastered at Deviant Lab Studio, while “BODY” was mixed and mastered by Thibault Chaumont at Deviant Lab Studio. Ahead of “MTNT”, HORSKH released three other singles during 2026: “BAD GLITCH” on January 22, “Hyperhuman” in March and “Glow” in June. “Connected”, featuring Carpenter Brut, followed on September 10. The band have also been active on the European festival circuit in 2026, with appearances listed at Wave-Gotik-Treffen in Leipzig, Castle Party in Bolków and Nocturnal Culture Night in Deutzen, alongside a series of French dates extending into November. The catalogue combines programmed electronics, guitars and live percussion across industrial, EBM and electro-adjacent territory, reflecting the band’s own album credits. About Carpenter Brut Carpenter Brut is the stage name of Franck Hueso, a French darksynth musician from Poitiers active since 2012. He released three EPs, “EP I” (2012), “EP II” (2013) and “EP III” (2015), later compiled as the album “Trilogy” (2015), followed by “Leather Teeth” (2018), the “Blood Machines” soundtrack (2020), “Leather Terror” (2022) and “Leather Temple” (2026). His releases since 2015 have come out through his own label, No Quarter Prod. In live performances, Carpenter Brut is joined by guitarist Adrien Grousset and drummer Florent Marcadet, both also members of the French metal band Hacride.
items._cn_summary: 法国工业电子项目HORSKH与Carpenter Brut合作的单曲"Connected"于2026年9月发行，作为其即将到来的专辑"MTNT"的预热作品。歌曲的歌词围绕电线、静脉连接、恐惧、化学幻觉等意象展开，将身体、技术与心理层面的依附关系紧密交织，赋予"连接"一词远超其字面含义的不安感。HORSKH近年作品融合吉他、电子编程与工业压迫感，从2017年首张专辑"GATE"到2024年"BODY"逐步深化这一路线。混音与母带由Thibault Chaumont在Deviant Lab Studio完成，与Carpenter Brut的"Leather Temple"共享技术团队。"MTNT"专辑定于2026年9月25日发行，收录十首曲目，由Wire Control厂牌通过Blood Blast Distribution独家授权发行。

items.body: Review by VianaProghead — Review N� 987"The Roaring Waves" is a collaborative album by two influential names in the European prog scene, Steve Hackett and Steve Rothery. As we know, Hackett was the main guitarist of Genesis and Rothery is the guitarist of Marillion. As we also know, Marillion was the band most close to Genesis of all British prog bands that appeared in the 80's. So, we can say that Rothery is, somehow, the heir of Hackett on guitars. So, we can not be surprised by this collaborative effort.Although the initial idea emerged around 2015, "The Roaring Waves" took nearly a decade to be written and recorded. The sessions were split between the Racket Club (Marillion's studio) and the home studios of both musicians. The strong connection between both solidified on stage when Rothery joined Hackett at the Royal Albert Hall in 2024 to play "Fly On A Windshield", one of the most famous tracks of the album "The Lamb Lies Down On Broadway" by Genesis.So, "The Roaring Waves" is the first instrumental collaborative project between two of the most iconic guitarists in progressive rock. The album is a profoundly cinematic, atmospheric and a melodic work, entirely inspired by the power, mysteries and nuances of the sea, beautifully paced conversation between two master guitarists. Instead of a flashy "speed trial" or shred-fest competition, the album prioritizes compositional patience, atmospheric depth, and melodic trade-offs. Hackett's angular, classical-tinged and experimental approach, merges seamlessly with Rothery's emotional soaring sustain. Having decided to completely forgo vocals and lyrics, the album gives the listener a true complete imaginative freedom through textures that blend progressive rock, classical music, ambient and electronic textures.The line up on "The Roaring Waves" is Steve Hackett (guitar and harmonica) and Steve Rothery (guitar, bass guitar and keyboards). "The Roaring Waves" also had the participation of Riccardo Romano (keyboards and bass guitar), Daniele Pomo and Leon Parr (drums)."The Storm" is the dramatic opening of the album. It begins by placing the listener in the midst of a storm, with the guitars intertwining to create the tension and force of a storm at sea. This is a beautiful, wild and cinematic piece that delights the listener, a track that serves more as an introduction to the album than in a particularly loud announcement. "Sandsend" is a more restful and contemplative track, where the tension eases, evoking a sense of isolation, a cool beauty and serene atmospheres. It veers a measured rhythm, toward elegant and melancholic atmospheres reminiscent of Pink Floyd, letting the guitars literally sing in unison. At under five minutes, the track is correspondingly compact. "Red Dragon" is the shortest track on the album where Hackett introduces the sitar guitar to give the composition a mystical and an oriental sound. It brings a touch of world music to the otherwise rather watertight soundscape with folkloric influences, bagpipes and sitar sounds. This is a more playful and less polished piece than its predecessors. The title track "The Roaring Waves" is probably the most compelling moment on the album. It begins with a beautiful flourish of classical guitar by Hackett. It's one of the album's highlights, the real swell. Slowly, the swelling dynamics, guitars giving each other space, and precisely that blend of melancholy and pathos for both Steves, a real classic prog moment. "K-129" is one of the most experimental and intriguing tracks on the album. Electronic soundscapes and dark guitars create a very own feeling. Once again, this rhythmic framework is layered over the two guitarists in a largely improvisational style. It stands out paying homage to the "Kosmische Musik" and the Berlin School of the 70's. It reminds me of "Gento", by Bisocope of last year, the project of Rothery and Thorsten Quaeschning of Tangerine Dream. For me, it's one of the strongest tracks on the album. "The Black Sea", described by the authors as a dark adventure, was chosen as the lead single of the album. It's one of the album's great melancholic beauties. Rothery's warm guitar meets Hackett's finely crafted timbres. This is precisely where it becomes clear why this collaboration makes any sense at all. "Pacific Coast Highway" departs from the gray and icy atmosphere of the previous tracks, an unexpected track. Here, the music gains rhythm and movement with Hackett playing harmonica and slide guitar, evoking a high-speed car trip along the sunny California coast. It's a lighthearted, road-movie-esque jam with plenty of vocals at the end of it.Conclusion: "The Roaring Waves" is a dialogue between two musicians who respect and listen to each other, and who have acquired the wisdom of guitarists who have nothing left to prove. It's, therefore, a mature, profound and extremely refined work. "The Roaring Waves" remains above all an album on which two guitarists thankfully dedicate themselves not to themselves, but to the respective piece and its shared concept. Hackett and Rothery harmonize superbly with each other, instead of getting lost in an endless competition for the more spectacular solo. Compared with the album "GTR" of Hackettt and Howe, this is a much better work. I know, those were the 80's. But I don't know if it's an excuse.Prog is my Ferrari. Jem Godfrey (Frost*)
items._cn_summary: 《The Roaring Waves》是Steve Hackett与Steve Rothery的首张器乐合作专辑，二人均为英式前卫摇滚领域的标志性吉他手——前者曾任Genesis主音吉他，后者则是Marillion的灵魂人物。专辑以海洋意象为核心主题，将两把吉他的对话置于电影化的氛围框架中展开，融合古典、氛围与电子纹理，强调旋律的交替递进而非炫技竞速。Hackett标志性的棱角分明、带有古典意味的实验性演奏，与Rothery感性绵长的延音线条形成互补。制作上完全舍弃人声，给予听众充分的想象空间。曲目如开篇的《The Storm》以交织的吉他模拟海上风暴的张力，《Sandsend》则转向冷静忧郁的沉思氛围，《Red Dragon》引入西塔琴吉他，融入东方世界音乐色彩。整体偏向氛围化、叙事化的前卫摇滚呈现，虽非激进实验，但器乐编排与跨文化音色运用具有一定深度。

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — The affirmation often has a psychological value that operates at an unconscious level; it begins from the outside and ends up taking hold internally. The Yes Album was a new beginning for many reasons: the first to feature Steve Howe, the first in which the compositions of Anderson, Chris Squire, and soon Howe would acquire that classic status and the first where rock, jazz, and a distinctive balance between acoustic and electric elements would find their signature style and a home within the progressive universe.There are many classic Yes lineups, and although the subsequent era might be considered the "classic of classics," the 1971 period is already worthy of that title. Gathering at Langley Farm, they recorded a handful of songs that would become enduring favorites, not only for that lineup but for those that followed, and have been performed live ever since.I'm a fan of the Peter Banks era, but Steve Howe, while retaining that affinity for rock 'n' roll, jazz, and classical music, brought a rhythm, a groove, and a fingering style, along with a cosmic dimension, that set the band apart right from "Yours Is No Disgrace." The vocal harmonies, often bordering on a cappella, were just one of many hallmarks that emerged with this album. The band also gained a warmth and an intimacy it hadn't possessed before; tracks like "Yours Is No Disgrace" featured not only instrumental sections but also intimate moments that made for a complete experience."Clap" is the first of many acoustic tracks by Steve Howe; composed of several sections, some with a pastoral, rustic feel and others with a distinct rock-and-roll vibe, the version that made the final cut was recorded live at London's Lyceum Theatre and would forever define one of the facets of this new Yes."Starship Trooper" must be one of the first tracks that made me fall in love with the band. Jon was gradually reaching the peak of his expressive potential, conveying a genuine emotion that was reinforced by Chris Squire on bass, Bill Bruford on drums, and, son, Steve Howe on guitar (who already seemed like a full-fledged member, even though Peter Banks still appeared on the album cover!). There was a palpable sense of communion as they focused on conveying their musical vision. Tony Kaye was solid, too, though he would later be succeeded by someone with such a massive aura that it would elevate "Starship Trooper" to even greater heights. Once again, the vocal harmonies and Jon's voice stood out... and just as the emotion reached its peak, "W�rm", the third section, would kick in. Steve would start off solo, with the rest of the band gradually joining him, creating a soundscape that felt like the prelude to a space voyage and the actual liftoff. And the first of many memorable riffs with an electrifying personality.The emotional momentum didn't let up, as a powerful new surge of feeling arrived with "I've Seen All Good People", a track that is 100% Yes. The band always drew sustenance from both the technical/virtuosic side and the spiritual/emotional one; neither works without the other, and it was their combination that gave birth to their best songs and albums. The track is neatly divided into two parts: the acoustic first section, "Your Move", which carries an almost Andean feel, and the rock-driven second half, "All Good People." The two work in tandem, creating the song's magical contrast."A Venture" is an atypical and unusual track within the context of the �lbum, and a very beautiful one. It features very interesting breaks and syncopated drum and guitar work from Howe and Bruford; towards the end, Chris's bass and Tony Kaye's distinctly jazzy solo leave you wishing they would keep playing like that for even longer."Perpetual Change" is the final track, and Bill Bruford's presence is as notable as it is significant; the format, an elaborate introduction leading into a fully developed song, set a precedent for what was to come. Hints of a country feel followed by a jazz-inflected progression, along with the polyrhythms and counterpoint in the finale, exemplified the band's high level of technical proficiency. Meanwhile, the vocal interplay between Jon and Chris offered a different facet, helping to create an album that holds a unique place in history. There are many layers to consider: while the band's subsequent work was undoubtedly more complex and elaborate, and is rightly regarded as some of their best, this album possesses its own distinct value. It stands as an equally great record, not for the same reasons as the later material, but for others; after all, as we have seen, Yes is a multi-dimensional band.
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / classic rock
items._cn_summary: 《The Yes Album》是Yes乐队1971年的转型之作，首次引入吉他手Steve Howe，标志着乐队风格的确立。专辑在伦敦Lyceum剧院及Langley Farm录制，融合摇滚、爵士与古典元素，呈现出电声与原声交织的平衡感。Steve Howe以独特的节奏律动与指法风格为乐队注入新维度，其原声曲目如"Clap"展现了田园质朴与摇滚气息的多段式结构。"Starship Trooper"由三个部分组成，Jon Anderson的声乐表达逐渐成熟，配合Chris Squire的贝斯与Bill Bruford的鼓点，形成层次丰富的声场。"I've Seen All Good People"延续了这种情感张力。整张专辑的和声编排常接近无伴奏形式，成为乐队的标志特征之一，为后续经典阵容奠定了基础。

items.body: Naples dark folk act Corde Oblique released the single “Emma” on September 11, 2026, the first track from their tenth studio album, “All’ombra dei fanciulli in fiore” (In the Shadow of Young Girls in Flower), due November 27 on German label Dark Vinyl Records. The title references Marcel Proust and centers on parenthood. Emma by Corde Oblique ‘Emma’ previews a 12-track album recorded in Naples and mastered at Abbey Road Corde Oblique, led by composer and art historian Riccardo Prencipe, recorded “All’ombra dei fanciulli in fiore” between Peppino di Capri’s Splash Studios in Naples and London, where it was mastered at Abbey Road Studios by Alex Wharton. The album runs 12 tracks plus a bonus track, mixed by Massimo Aluzzi, and moves across metal, prog rock, folk songwriting and dark wave elements. The band’s core lineup on the record is Prencipe on classical and electric guitar, Alfredo Notarloberti on violin, Alessio Sica on drums, Umberto Lepore on bass and Rita Saviano on vocals. Guest contributors include singer-songwriter Andrea Chimenti, a voice of the Italian New Wave scene, on three tracks, and actress Maddalena Crippa, who provides a spoken-word performance. The digipak and booklet use vintage 1980s photographs of Pozzuoli and the Campi Flegrei (Phlegraean Fields), tying the album to the region where it was recorded. Corde Oblique open a promotional tour on October 24 at the Schwarzer Herbst Festival in Löbau, Germany, followed by Italian dates at Teatro Bolivar in Naples on November 20 and at Improve in Castelfranco Veneto on November 21. About Corde Oblique Corde Oblique is an Italian dark folk project founded and led by Naples-based composer and art historian Riccardo Prencipe. Side-Line has followed the band’s output since at least 2018, and covered their 2020 album “The Moon Is a Dry Bone.” “Emma” and the accompanying album “All’ombra dei fanciulli in fiore” mark the band’s tenth full-length and its first new release on Dark Vinyl Records, continuing a catalog built on the intersection of classical guitar, folk songwriting and darker, heavier textures.
items._genre: dark folk / neoclassical / progressive rock / darkwave
items._cn_summary: 意大利那不勒斯暗潮民谣乐队 Corde Oblique 由作曲家兼艺术史学者 Riccardo Prencipe 领军，发布第十张录音室专辑及先行单曲。这张作品以普鲁斯特《在少女们身旁》为题，聚焦为人父母的主题，音乐横跨金属、前卫摇滚、民谣创作与暗潮元素。专辑在传奇的 Splash Studios 录音，经 Abbey Road 工作室母带处理，制作阵容包含古典与电吉他、小提琴、鼓、贝斯与人声，并邀来意大利新浪潮歌手 Andrea Chimenti 与演员 Maddalena Crippa 加盟。封套采用1980年代 Pozzuoli 与坎帕尼亚火山区老照片，将听觉与地域文化记忆紧密勾连。那不勒斯作为欧洲地中海城市，其文化背景为这张专辑带来独特的地域叙事。整体呈现出学院气质与暗色调的融合，介于当代古典与暗潮之间的跨界探索。

items.body: Projekt Records releases Norwegian ambient musician Erik Wøllo‘s new album Earthshine on 18 September 2026. The album is available as a Pay What You Can digital release and as a CD limited to 300 copies, packaged in a 4-panel digipak. Earthshine by Erik Wøllo The title refers to earthshine, the sunlight reflected from the earth’s surface that faintly illuminates the part of the moon not directly lit by the sun. Across 20 short tracks that crossfade into one another, “Earthshine” moves through abstract electronic soundscapes built from processed drones and sequencer pulses, alternating between expressive passages and sparser, hushed sections. The CD edition also includes a 21st, gapless version of the full album as a single continuous piece. Wøllo recorded the album to analog 4-track and 8-track tape machines before transferring the material to computer for further arranging and mixing, a return to the recording approach he used in the 1980s. Explaining why he went back to tape for “Earthshine”, Wøllo said: “When the tape is running, something affects me, I descend into myself, realizing music completely in the moment. I wanted to go back to the way of recording I was into in the 1980s, using old analog tape recorders. How would it affect my compositional process? Would it take me in other compositional directions? Compare it to writing a novel with a pencil instead of a computer. The unhurried measured approach was more time-consuming and led me to make different creative choices. It turned out that the music became more fluid and open-ended.” Beyond the Projekt Records Bandcamp page, “Earthshine” is also available through Projekt’s distribution partners deejaydead.de, littleuniversemusic.co.uk and audioglobe.it. About Erik Wøllo Erik Wøllo was born on 6 January 1961 in Hemsedal, Norway. He started playing guitar at age 11 and began his professional career in 1980, touring Norway in jazz, rock and fusion bands before turning to a full-time solo career in 1984, when he built his own studio, Wintergarden. His third album, “Traces” (1985, Cicada Records), marked a turning point toward the guitar-and-synthesizer-based ambient and space music style that has defined his solo work since. Wøllo has released more than 50 solo albums, moving through labels including Origo Sound, Monumental Records and Spotted Peccary Music before settling with Projekt Records, which has issued his work since “Gateway” (2010) and remains his current label. His catalog includes “Silent Currents” (2011), “Different Spaces” (2017), “Recurrence” (2021), “Sojourns” (2022) and “Snow Tides” (2026), among others. He has also released collaborative albums with Steve Roach (“Stream of Thought”, 2009, and “The Road Eternal”, 2011), Michael Stearns (“Convergence”, 2020), Ian Boddy (“Frontiers”, 2012, “Meridian”, 2018, and “Revolve”, 2023), and Byron Metcalf (“Earth Luminous”, 2016), among others. “Revolve”, made with Ian Boddy, won the Schallwelle Award for best ambient album in 2023. Wøllo contributed a rework to Apoptygma Berzerk’s 25th-anniversary album “SDGXXV”, having worked with the band in the studio during the making of their 1993 debut “Soli Deo Gloria”. He has also performed at Chuck van Zyl’s Star’s End “Gatherings” concert series in Philadelphia, alongside artists including Steve Roach and Robert Rich. “Earthshine” extends his ongoing run of releases on Projekt Records into a new recording method rooted in his earliest analog tape work.
items._cn_summary: 挪威音乐人Erik Wøllo的新专辑以地球反照为概念，标题来源于照射在月球未被阳光直射部分的地球反射光。整张专辑由20首短曲交叉淡入淡出串联而成，整体由处理过的嗡鸣声和序列器脉冲构成抽象电子音景，在表达性段落与稀疏安静段落之间交替往返。CD版本额外包含第21首的无缝连续完整版本。录音方式上回归1980年代的模拟四轨与八轨磁带机，后期再转入电脑进行编曲混音。Wøllo在采访中谈到磁带录音带来的即时沉浸感和不同创作选择，使音乐变得更加流动与开放。此外还介绍了他的成长经历、五十余张个人专辑的丰富履历，以及与Steve Roach、Michael Stearns、Ian Boddy等氛围音乐家的合作经历。

items.body: Swedish goth pioneers The Bizarre Orkeztra have reissued “Land” as a 2026 remaster, out now through COMEDIA in collaboration with Ambush Records. The track is the first release in a new series of remastered singles drawn from the band’s catalog. “Land” was written by Sonny Jansson and originally released in 1984 as a 12″ single on Ambush Records, the band’s own indie label. The original tracklist, “Land,” “Korridor,” “Justice” and “Travelling Man,” was recorded by Christer Björklund at The Bizarre Orkeztra’s headquarters, with vocals recorded by Jomma Sundström at Gävle Ljudstudio and production by Bob Boxkopf. Copies of the 12″ came with an eight-page comic booklet, “The No! COMIX No.2,” made specifically for the release. For the 2026 edition, the title track has been remastered by Håkan Nilsson, with Richard Solstjärna serving as executive producer and providing the new cover art. The single is available digitally, including on Spotify, with a release date of 16 September 2026. COMEDIA describes the campaign as presenting “carefully selected highlights drawn from the band’s impressive back catalog.” It is not the first time “Land” has reached digital platforms: the track was previously issued as a remastered digital reissue in 2020, at the time as part of a monthly reissue project with a companion schedule that also covered “Visions On The Wall,” “Midnight Show,” “A Beautiful Place,” “Hunger For Pleasure” and “She’s Got.” The 2026 edition relaunches that catalog campaign as a new series of remastered singles. About The Bizarre Orkeztra The Bizarre Orkeztra formed in Gävle, Sweden, in the early 1980s, emerging from the punk rock band PF Commando and the avant-garde post-punk band Modaern Art. The band was among the first goth acts in Sweden. Its original lineup was Sonny Jansson on vocals and guitars, Richard Sandberg on drums and guitar, and Ola Claesson on bass and backing vocals; Håkan Nilsson later joined on synthesizer for the group’s later recordings. “Land” was the band’s debut release under The Bizarre Orkeztra name, following the 1981 recording “Ingen kärlek, Inget hat,” released under the group’s earlier name, Bizarre Sex. Two studio albums followed on Ambush Records: “Visions On The Wall” in 1985 and “A Beautiful Place” in 1987, along with the singles “Midnight Show” in 1986 and “She’s Got” in 1989. The album “Hunger For Pleasures,” released in 1988, featured Joakim Lindgren on saxophone alongside Nilsson’s synthesizer work. The band released three albums and several singles in total before disbanding in the late 1980s. Bass player Ola “Toli” Claesson, who died in 2009, created cover art for several of the band’s albums and singles, including the comic strip made for “Land,” which was handed out to the audience at the band’s first concert in Gävle. COMEDIA’s new remastered singles series revisits that catalog, beginning again with the track that first introduced The Bizarre Orkeztra to record buyers in 1984.
items._cn_summary: 本文为瑞典哥特先驱The Bizarre Orkeztra 1984年单曲"Land"的2026年再版消息。该作品原为乐队在Ambush Records旗下发行的12寸单曲，包含"Korridor"、"Justice"、"Travelling Man"等曲目，附带八页漫画册。2026年版由Håkan Nilsson负责remaster，Richard Solstjärna担任执行制作并提供新封面。乐队源自Gävle，从PF Commando和Modaern Art演变而来，是瑞典最早的哥特乐队之一，融合了朋克与前卫后朋克基因。整体内容偏向新闻发布性质，缺乏对音乐本体（声响设计、创作理念）的深度评述。

items.body: Sudan Dudan is a Norwegian duo, Marit Karlberg and Anders Erik R�ine, who have released four albums over the last twenty years. On M�rke refrenger , their fifth, they are joined by Hans Hulb�kmo and Magnus Skavhaug Nergaard, contributing instrumentally and with the production. There are eight songs on the album with accompaniment principally led by acoustic guitar, augmented by fiddles, langeleik, lyre, jaws harp and more. The opening track, �Gard og grind� (�Fence and gate�) is a fine introduction to what is to come: finger-picked acoustic guitar, fiddle, bass and snare-drum played with brushes leading into the harmonized vocal, together creating an alluring sound drawing the listener in. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The mood of the album, reflected in its title which translates as �Dark Refrains,� is not always dark, but most of the material, including the title track, certainly has a reflective quality. According to the press release �the lyrics smoulder with unease about the present and the future, while looking back to the myths and riddles of the past. They speak of the earth, the sun, the moon, stars and planets, of lost brothers, quarrelling sisters, loss and grief, of the power of imagination, and of the answers to the simplest and most difficult riddles.� The lyrics of all the songs, in Norwegian, are included in the sleeve notes and while a hasty online translation can aid with some understanding, the full meanings tend to remain cryptic, but there is a sense that words and music complement each other. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan For all its dark moodiness, M�rke refrenger does have its lighter moments. �Bagatelle� recalls and reinvents the melody of a well-known French song, adding some off-kilter harmonies, while �Rulleball� is more characteristically Norwegian, employing a vocal style known as tralling in which words are replaced by a vocalization of the melody, originally used to accompany dances when no instrument was available. No translation necessary there. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The final track �Skriften p� veggen� (�the writing on the wall�) features, for the only time on the album, electric guitar. The sound is deep and twangy, shades of Duane Eddy or a David Lynch soundtrack and it works very well. All in all a fine, imaginatively conceived and beautifully produced record, available as a download or vinyl. Find the artists online. items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items.body: For an overview of the what, the why, and the where of this music, do read my review of Volume 1 of this series. Essentially, this collection is more of what made Volume 1 so infectious. Yet, what makes this music so fascinating in general, that is, beyond its unswerving ability to fill dance floors, is the fact that these two islands, part of the Paises Africanos de Lingua Oficial Portuguesa (PALOP) regions of the world, are the second smallest African country; Seychelles is smaller. There are only 12 villages on Sao Tom�, lots of rain forest and, not surprisingly, lots of rain. I mention this because one could be fooled into thinking, with music like what�s on offer here, there must have been a music scene larger than there actually was. Not that little was happening, but that less got recorded or released than it might have had there been a city such as Lagos or Nairobi with the studios, labels, and pressing plants to better document it all. The music here, like Volume 1- recorded during Africa�s so-called golden age- is known as Puxa, a complex stew of ingredients from other former African Portuguese colonies mixed with rhythms that, with the help of dancers, can summon spirits or exorcise demons. At least according to some. It�s worth knowing that a 100 years or so ago, the Portuguese banned Puxa dance; it�s also worth knowing they appear to have failed miserably at this silly endeavor. Tucked away in modern Puxa is merengue, Kompas, Soukouss, Benga, and much else. One suspects much of this is coincidental, while other grooves were definitely imported considering both Portuguese rule and the islands� location over the Atlantic from the Caribbean. But don�t be fooled into thinking these two islands don�t have their own thing, as the sounds on this collection show. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s - Pedro Lima Pedro Lima, who has featured in his own Bongo Joe collection, leads a fiery band, complete with choked guitar vamps tussling with a kit drummer as a lead guitar comments from the sidelines on �Sossegado.� Elsewhere, Sangazuza demonstrates what happens when the bass and keys drop out, leaving the drummers and guitars to ride out a groove and drive dancers mad in the process. Check �Sono s� ku� de t�ma� or �Mairo bi cedo� for their ability to place a firm finger on the pulse. Over 15 tracks, the collection shows off multiple guitars weaving and circling one another, with lead and harmony vocals constantly in response, becoming part of the songs� melodic framework. At any given moment, vocals give way as the music unspools and floats on grooves that must have gone on for hours live. Africa Negra�s �Apoi�mos a luta dos nossos irm�os� is one example. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s by Various Artists In general, what�s on offer here, like Volume 1, was recorded at Radio Sao Tom� e Principe (RSTP), often taped in the courtyard outside at night, and released on cassette or occasionally, vinyl. It captures the joy of post-1975 independence and only fizzled out as styles changed and musicians struggled to make ends meet. Yet, take a quick listen to recent RSTP programming, which features musicians such as Babilonia or Calema, and you�ll still hear Puxa rhythms, showing just how potent the music form this two-island nation is on a global level. And Bongo Joe, who have also released two volumes featuring the above mentioned Africa Negra, have given this music the treatment it deserves, with extensive notes on the country�s history, vintage photographs, and band discographies. Various Artists - L�ve L�ve (Volume1) (Review) Pedro Lima - Maguidala (Review) Ann O'aro - Bleu (Review)

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑收录了圣多美和普林西比1970至80年代的Puxa音乐录音，属于非洲葡萄牙语国家在独立前后文化交融时期的声音档案。乐评指出，Puxa是一种融合merengue、Kompas、Soukouss、Benga等多种流派的复合节奏，在葡语非洲殖民地与加勒比海的跨洋交流中形成，但同时保留了岛屿自身的音乐特性。评论特别强调贝斯与键盘退场后鼓与吉他构建的舞蹈律动，以及多把吉他交织盘旋的编曲特点。Pedro Lima领衔的乐队展示了闷声吉他即兴段与鼓组间的对峙，Africa Negra的作品则呈现人声在旋律框架中的应答关系。乐评背景补充了圣多美小国仅有12个村庄、音乐记录有限的史实背景，使这些录音本身具有文献价值。整体聚焦在舞池感染力与历史语境，而非实验性声音探索。

items._cn_summary: 这是一篇关于印尼加里曼丹音乐家Nursalim Yadi Anugerah的播放列表介绍文章。文章主要呈现一段简短的艺术家背景介绍，并未深入探讨具体音乐作品的创作手法、声音设计或艺术理念。文中提到该音乐家的作品曾在CTM Festival、transmediale、Time:Spans Festival和Holland Festival等重要实验音乐与当代艺术节上演，表明其活跃于欧洲前沿艺术音乐圈。从文化背景来看，其创作深度结合了加里曼丹（婆罗洲）的文化与生态现实，具有明显的地方文化视角。然而，文章正文内容极为简短，缺乏对音乐本身的实质性描述与评论，无法判断其具体的艺术手法和创新程度。作为一档播放列表推荐栏目，文章更像是一个艺术家入口介绍，而非完整乐评。

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑聚焦于挪威传统乐器哈当厄尔小提琴（Hardanger Fiddle），其独特之处在于琴弦下方的隐藏共鸣弦，使音色产生空灵的双层共鸣效果。专辑汇集新一代演奏者，探讨这一传统乐器在当代语境下的延展可能，试图让这一挪威民间声音走向更广阔的听众。文章来自Bandcamp Daily的简短预告，篇幅极为有限，仅介绍了乐器特性与专辑概念，未能展开具体的音乐分析、演奏技法或编曲手法的深入讨论。作为对挪威民间音乐传统的记录与推广，它具有一定的文化价值，但对于追求实验性、跨界融合或前卫声响的听众而言，传统民谣的基底可能仍显保守。

items.body: In this month’s antidote to the algorithm, Mary Chiney introduces tQ subscribers to a subculture that thrived on the fringes of the Afrobeats explosion Lady Donli, via artist's Bandcamp If you cast an eye toward West Africa over the last decade, you’d be forgiven for viewing Nigerian music as a cultural giant. The global explosion of Afrobeats, a very polished juggernaut led for many years by the likes of Burna Boy, Wizkid, and Davido, has dominated the narrative, filling dancefloors from London to Los Angeles. At the same time, beneath mainstream Lagos, a quiet rebellion has emerged. It happened on SoundCloud, at underground thrift pop-ups, and in the bedrooms of kids who felt entirely alienated by the commercial club sound. They called... The post Organic Intelligence LX: Nigerian Alté appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: 这篇乐评聚焦尼日利亚另类音乐场景，将其定位为主流Afrobeats之外的地下反叛力量。文章指出，过去十年间Burna Boy、Wizkid、Davido等明星推动的Afrobeats成为西非音乐的文化标签，但与此同时，一个名为Alté的亚文化群体在SoundCloud、地下集市和卧室中悄然生长，这群年轻人与商业俱乐部音乐保持距离，追求更独立、另类的声音表达。评论人Mary Chiney为读者梳理了这条被主流叙事掩盖的支线，通过Lady Donli等艺术家的作品呈现尼日利亚音乐的另一面。Alté作为一种美学态度，融合了R&B、嘻哈、电子与实验元素，强调个人化制作和反商业姿态，与全球独立音乐潮流存在共振。

items.body: “Caminando Por La Playa” means walking along the beach, yet Aldo Zolev wrote it about a happy day marching through Bogotá, a city more than 2,600 metres up in the Andes and hundreds of kilometres from the sea. The percussion sets a brisk marching step through the instrumental, with Sandro Londoño on cymbals. Sandra Duque plays the melody on bassoon over Zolev’s double bass. Zolev describes the piece as energetic and lively, built on a memory of Colombian rhythms, and says the walk stands for a way through life, urging his friends to walk “por la vida hoy y siempre“, through life today and always, and to be happy. Zolev comes from Pamplona, a small Andean city in north-eastern Colombia near the Venezuelan border, where his grandfather, a professional double bassist, started him on the instrument. He moved to Bogotá to study double bass at the conservatory of the Universidad Nacional de Colombia and took jazz and harmony lessons with saxophonist Antonio Arnedo. He formed the world-jazz group Dos Aguas and later played in Bereket, an ensemble devoted to Turkish and Middle Eastern music. In 2007 he set up EnnO, the independent Bogotá label and studio that has since produced 25 albums and runs its own world music festival. Three years later he launched UVA Sexteto, bringing the oud in alongside his double bass. He has also recorded with MARIAZÚ, whose album Eau de Vie – Agua Ardiente was cut outdoors in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, with birdsong and running water around acoustic instruments and indigenous percussion. In 2025 Zolev relaunched Sensaciones Bajo La Lluvia, the album that carries “Caminando Por La Playa”, and he has just come back from a summer tour of Europe. Listen to “Caminando Por La Playa” and the full Sensaciones Bajo La Lluvia album HERE The post Daily Discovery: Aldo Zolev – Caminando Por La Playa appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由哥伦比亚低音提琴演奏家Aldo Zolev录制，曲目《Caminando Por La Playa》以打击乐设定明快的行进节奏，Camilo Londoño负责镲片演奏，Sandra Duque用巴松管吹奏主旋律，与Zolev的低音提琴形成声部对话。作品灵感来自波哥大街头漫步的记忆，将哥伦比亚传统节奏与现代爵士器乐编制结合。作为EnnO厂牌创始人，Zolev的音乐轨迹跨越土耳其与中东音乐（参与Bereket乐团）、将乌德琴纳入爵士六重奏（UVA Sexteto），并与MARIAZÚ合作在圣玛尔塔内华达山进行户外录音，融入鸟叫与流水声。整体呈现拉丁美洲世界爵士融合的跨文化探索，发行渠道独立小众。

items.body: Argentine post-punk project Zudpöl releases the single Disciple: In Control on 11 September 2026, through the Buenos Aires label Catálogo Negro / No Me Escucho Records (NMER). The two-track release pairs the title song “Disciple” with the B-side “In Control”, sitting between dark post-punk and the club sound of the late 1980s and early 1990s. Both tracks were built on a vintage drum machine, a mini analog synthesizer, a pocket sampler, guitar and bass, with software used only for the final edit. No Me Escucho Records describes the approach as “simple hardware and no virtual instruments”, the same method Zudpöl has used on its earlier releases. The Bandcamp page embeds the single below. Disciple: In Control by Zudpöl Zudpöl on Catálogo Negro since its 2022 debut “Disciple: In Control” is issued under the Catálogo Negro imprint of No Me Escucho Records, the label that has released Zudpöl’s catalog since 2022. NMER previously put out the free covers compilation “NMER C-01 2024”, on which Zudpöl contributed a version of Death In June’s “Fall Apart”. About Zudpöl Zudpöl is a post-punk, darkwave and coldwave project released through No Me Escucho Records, the independent label founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina by Darío Martinez and Diego Centurión, joined in 2021 by Ferran Pont Vergés. Zudpöl debuted on NMER in 2022 with the album “A Weaker Sun”, followed in June 2023 by the single “In Fear” and, on 24 November 2023, by the six-track album “Last Lights”, which extended the project’s coldwave core with ethereal and dream-pop textures. In January 2025, Zudpöl contributed a cover of Death In June’s “Fall Apart” to NMER’s free “NMER C-01 2024” covers compilation. All of these releases share the same production method: hardware synthesizers, samplers and drum machines, without virtual instruments. “Disciple: In Control” is Zudpöl’s first single since “Last Lights”, continuing that hardware-based approach on Catálogo Negro.
items._cn_summary: 阿根廷后朋克与暗潮项目 Zudpöl 发行双曲单曲《Disciple: In Control》，由布宜诺斯艾利斯独立厂牌 Catálogo Negro / No Me Escucho Records 推出。作品定位介于黑暗后朋克与八十年代末至九十年代初俱乐部声响之间，硬件配置以复古鼓机、小型模拟合成器、便携采样器、吉他与贝斯为核心，仅在终混阶段使用软件，延续了该艺术家自2022年首张专辑以来坚持的"纯硬件、无虚拟乐器"制作路线。此前作品在冷浪潮基底上已尝试融入氛围与梦幻流行质感，本次单曲延续这一硬件美学，未引入新的跨界元素。整张作品属于类型内常规运作，以独立地下姿态维持小规模传播，未展现出对既有风格的拓展或声音实验的推进。

items.body: New York darkwave duo Ghostbells released “The Silence” on September 17, 2026 through Out Of Line Music, as a digital single with an accompanying music video. It is the second piece of original material Jessica Perry and Jim Finley have put out since their debut EP “Catacouture” arrived in February, following “Curses” in August. The Silence by ghostbells The track returns to the confessional side of the duo’s sound: 80s and new wave melody laid over a 90s EBM pulse, pushed forward by the kind of driving, dancefloor-ready arrangement that keeps its darker moments moving rather than static. The lyric follows someone consumed by sadness and reaching for a version of life that used to feel joyful, with a plea that goes nowhere: Can someone save me / I hear nothing / it’s the silence that takes me. Ghostbells described the writing behind the song directly. “The Silence is about being consumed by sadness and longing for times before, when there used to be a joy for life. There is a cry for help but it seems useless when it goes unanswered.” Jessica Perry named the source more specifically: “Struggles that I have personally endured and some of the lowest times in life.” Ghostbells follow Dark Summer Open Air with ‘The Silence’ “The Silence” lands right after one of the duo’s largest shows to date. On September 12, Ghostbells played Dark Summer Open Air Vol. 2 at Wasserschloss Klaffenbach in Chemnitz, Germany, alongside Blutengel and Chrom, in front of roughly 3,000 people. In just over a year since signing to Out Of Line, the pair have built a run of remix work alongside their own releases, reworking Blutengel’s “Schwarzer Engel”, Cemetery Skyline’s “Torn Away” and Blitz Union’s “Evolution”. The single carries that momentum into a run of US club dates and a full Latin American tour supporting label-mates Hocico, followed by European festival dates into next year. Tour dates for Ghostbells in 2026 and 2027 September 19, 2026 – Los Angeles, CA, USA – Bar Sinister September 23 – October 4, 2026 – Hocico “Unseen Horror Scenes” tour support October 29, 2026 – Fort Worth, TX, USA – Haltom Theatre October 30, 2026 – Houston, TX, USA – Scout Bar November 13, 2026 – Tampa, FL, USA – New World Tampa November 14, 2026 – Miami, FL, USA – Las Rosas November 20-21, 2026 – Wangels, Germany – Plage Noire Festival November 28, 2026 – Essen, Germany – Obsidian Echoes Festival July 24-25, 2027 – Cologne, Germany – Amphi Festival About Ghostbells Ghostbells are a duo from New York City: Jessica Perry on vocals, guitar, bass and synth, and Jim Finley on production, vocals, bass, guitar and synth. The project signed to Berlin label Out Of Line Music in 2025 and released its first single, “Darkness Saves“, that August. Three digital EPs followed before year’s end, and the duo’s debut EP proper, “Catacouture”, arrived on Out Of Line on February 5, 2026, collecting six tracks including “Darkness Saves”, “Ghosts”, “Wrath” and “Cry4Her” and giving the band its first CD pressing. Since then, Ghostbells have kept up a steady release and touring pace: a run of remixes for Blutengel, Cemetery Skyline and Blitz Union, the “Curses” single and video in August, and festival and club dates across the UK, Europe and the US. “The Silence” is their second original track since “Catacouture”, released as the band works toward its debut full-length album, and it opens a touring stretch that runs from Los Angeles through Latin America to the Amphi Festival in Germany next summer.

items.body: Infacted Recordings launches the Zoth Ommog Classix series, a vinyl-only reissue line reviving catalog from the German EBM and electro-industrial label Zoth Ommog. The first release is a limited grey-vinyl pressing of Lights Of Euphoria’s 1995 debut album “Brainstorm“, out 16 October 2026, followed on 23 October by Menschdefekt’s fifth studio album “Into the Void” on CD. Zoth Ommog was founded by Talla 2XLC after he left Techno Drome International. Its first release was Italian electro act Pankow’s “Kunst & Wahnsinn” EP. Talla continued T.D.I.’s early program with artists including Bigod 20, Aircrash Bureau, Leæther Strip, X Marks the Pedwalk and Armageddon Dildos. Torben Schmidt, founder of Infacted Recordings, worked as Zoth Ommog’s label manager from 1995 to 1998. He and Talla launched the Zoth Ommog Classix series together. “Brainstorm” track listing: This Is the Point, Brainstorm, Give Me You, Reaching Out, Energy & Consciousness, Misery, Sacred, Ice Machine (vox version), Serenade (splitter), Subjection (violated), No Tears, Face of a God, Dead Bodies. Menschdefekt’s “Into the Void” arrives 23 October on CD (catalog FACT3483, EAN 4018939613945) in a clear tray jewel box, its first full-length album with vocalist Alex Erbacher. The 14-track, roughly 70-minute record moves between synth pop, dark electro and future pop, and includes two tracks reaching CD for the first time: a cover of Bronski Beat’s “Smalltown Boy” and “Day by Day”, a collaboration with Mark Sousa of Voicecoil, who died earlier in 2026. “Into the Void” will also be released digitally via Bandcamp and on streaming platforms. “Into the Void” track listing: Into the Void, Inside the Machine, Black as Black Can Be, Fragile Existence Part I, Losing Fire, The Book of Life, Reality, This World, Scream in Silence, Smalltown Boy, Oblivion, God, Embrace Your Fate, plus bonus track Day by Day (Album Version feat. Mark Sousa). The Zoth Ommog Classix series also keeps in print earlier Lights Of Euphoria releases “Future Unknown” and “True Life” on vinyl, the “Suicidal” MCD and “Traumatized” CD, plus Menschdefekt‘s “Recombination” CD. About Lights Of Euphoria and Menschdefekt Lights Of Euphoria is a German EBM act that released “Brainstorm” on Zoth Ommog in 1995, one of the label’s catalog titles from its run as a driving force in European electronic music through the 1990s. The album’s Zoth Ommog Classix reissue marks its first-ever appearance on vinyl, 31 years after its original CD release. Menschdefekt build a sound bridging synth pop, dark electro and future pop, marked by clean vocals, trance-inspired synthesizer structures and the band’s spoken-word samples. “Into the Void” is the group’s fifth studio album and its first to feature vocalist Alex Erbacher, presenting a more melodic and accessible side of the band while staying rooted in its electronic origins.

items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的乐评，而是关于Infacted Recordings推出Zoth Ommog Classix黑胶再版系列以及Menschdefekt新专辑发布的资讯类报道。该系列首张作品为Lights Of Euphoria 1995年首张专辑《Brainstorm》的限量灰胶再版，这是该专辑首次以黑胶形式发行，距原版CD发行已过去31年。Menschdefekt第五张录音室专辑《Into the Void》同时发布，收录14首约70分钟的曲目，融合合成器流行、暗电子与未来流行风格，并包含对Bronski Beat名曲《Smalltown Boy》的翻唱版本，以及与已故艺术家Mark Sousa合作的曲目。文章追溯了Zoth Ommog厂牌由Talla 2XLC创立的历程，以及该厂牌在1990年代欧洲电子音乐场景中的核心地位，包括对Bigod 20、Leæther Strip、Armageddon Dildos等代表性艺人的发掘。整体内容以发行信息和厂牌历史为主，缺乏对音乐本身的深度分析与审美评价。

items.body: KN/GHTS, the solo project of James Knights, releases the single “Light The Fuse” on 17 September 2026 via Specchio Uomo. Knights is known as one of the singers of electronic pioneers Boytronic and for his time in Scarlet Soho. “Light The Fuse” combines synth pop, dark disco and Italo-influenced sounds. The track deals with loss, recovery and the moment someone stops looking backward and finds the strength to move forward. The single’s B-side carries a darker remix of “Supernatural Lover” by Berlin-based artist Daniel Knutz, whose own sound draws on darkwave, coldwave, post-punk and minimal electronic music. The official video for “Light The Fuse” was directed and edited by independent filmmaker Dirk Roche. It was filmed during the Supernatural Lover Tour, with additional footage captured at live performances in Germany. “Light The Fuse” follows KN/GHTS’s second studio album, “Supernatural Lover”. Since that release, the project has built momentum internationally, with an audience particularly across Germany, Sweden and Mexico. Its live show has become a central part of the project’s identity, with recent performances alongside Drab Majesty and Andy Bell of Erasure. Light The Fuse by KNIGHT$ “Light The Fuse” is available on Bandcamp and Spotify. About KN/GHTS KN/GHTS is the solo project of James Knights, known for his work across the electronic and alternative music scene as one of the singers of Boytronic and for his time in Scarlet Soho. Under the KN/GHTS name, Knights combines synth pop, dark disco, electronic music and theatrical performance. Following the release of his second studio album, “Supernatural Lover”, KN/GHTS built an international following, particularly across Germany, Sweden and Mexico. Live performances alongside acts including Drab Majesty and Andy Bell of Erasure became a defining part of the project. “Light The Fuse”, released 17 September 2026 via Specchio Uomo, is the project’s newest single, backed with a Daniel Knutz remix of “Supernatural Lover” and an official video shot during and after the Supernatural Lover Tour.

items.body: Electronic duo ZoZo released the two-track EP “TR-3B” on September 15, 2026, together with a music video for the title track directed by John Mannion. The EP holds “Rezorpt Into The Frequency” and “TR-3B”; ZoZo wrote, performed and produced it, and Beau Thomas mastered it. The video follows the activity of an alleged secret government aircraft rumored to have existed since the 1990s, staging a surreal abduction across shifting experiments and hallucinatory imagery that touches on hidden knowledge, extraterrestrial contact and dimensional timeline shifts. The duo describes the EP itself as “a result of many years of research into the realms of the paranormal, metaphysics, unexplained phenomena, and ET contact”, built from fluid passages, splintered rhythms and futuristic imagery. TR-3B by ZoZo About ZoZo ZoZo is the duo of Zoe Wardlaw and John Mannion, who started the project in New York City in 2016 and are now based in the Mojave Desert. Both members have backgrounds as classically trained performers and in the noise and experimental underground, which they carry into a vocal-driven electronic sound built on complex rhythms, processed vocals and unconventional song structures. The project’s debut single “Faceshuttle”, made with Bayley Sweitzer, appeared on December 4, 2020, ahead of the debut EP “Simulations of Self” on January 14, 2021; the single “Blood-Brain Barrier” followed in 2022. ZoZo’s work has been covered by Sermon 3 Recordings, The Wire, Ears to Feed and A Closer Listen. “TR-3B” is the project’s first release since “Simulations of Self”.
items._cn_summary: ZoZo 是由 Zoe Wardlaw 与 John Mannion 组成的双人项目，背景横跨古典训练与噪音实验地下场景，驻地莫哈维沙漠。TR-3B EP 仅含两首曲目，是其继 2021 年首张 EP 之后的首发新作，制作与编写均由二人独立完成，Beau Thomas 负责母带。整张作品建立在多年对超自然、形而上学与外星接触等主题的研究之上，标题曲同名音乐录像由 John Mannion 执导，围绕传闻中自九十年代起存在的神秘政府飞行器展开，呈现一系列扭曲的实验场景与幻觉式影像，触及隐秘知识、地外接触与维度时间线偏移等概念。音乐层面以流动段落、碎片化节奏与未来感声景为骨架，结合经过处理的人声与非常规歌曲结构，延续了从首支单曲 Faceshuttle 以来的声音脉络，整体定位偏向地下实验电子范畴。
